Thanks — I reviewed BrightSky_OrderForm_v3 and put together suggested language. Attaching a clean suggested text file and a redline of the OF (BR-OF-v3_redlines.docx). High-level notes below.

1) Publicity / logo use: keep permission narrow. Suggested clause (clean):
"Customer grants Redwood the limited right to use Customer's name and logo solely to identify Customer as a Redwood customer on Redwood's website and in customer lists, and to reference Customer in non-confidential marketing materials (press releases, blog posts) subject to Customer's prior written approval of each item, which approval shall not be unreasonably withheld. Customer will have ten (10) business days to review and provide comments on any proposed press release or case study. After the review window, absence of objection will be deemed approval."

Rationale: this preserves the customer's ability to approve text and logos, sets a review window (10 business days per Sophie), and uses a reasonable fallback (deemed approval) to avoid hold-ups. If BrightSky insists on a hard stop (no deemed approval), acceptability is up to the sales team.

2) Confidentiality carveout for aggregated metrics: we can allow sharing of aggregated, non-identifiable performance metrics (e.g., ">95% accuracy on dataset X in aggregate") provided the numbers are limited to non-sensitive, non-customer-specific measures and Redwood has the right to include them only with Customer's written consent. Suggest we explicitly exclude any raw PII, customer-specific metrics, or benchmark data tied to BrightSky's proprietary datasets.

3) Case study vs reference: separate rights. Reference (short quotes, company listing) can be covered by the OF. Case study that includes customer logos, quotes, or specific metrics should require separate written case study agreement.

4) Approval owner: request that BrightSky designate a single legal contact (Amanda) and a marketing contact. That reduces back-and-forth.

I've included the suggested exact wording in the attached BR-OF_v3_Legal_Suggested_Text.docx. If sales wants to be more generous on deemed approval or longer review windows, flag that now.

---
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
